title: NULL ops->update dereference on write
description: Provider registers with NULL update callback. User calls INIT, then write(). Line src/cdev/crypto2dev_fd.c:372 calls ops->update() with no NULL check. Outcome: NULL function pointer dereference, kernel panic.
close_reason: Added NULL guards for ops->sess_init, ops->update, ops->finalize in crypto2dev_fd.c; returns -EOPNOTSUPP on NULL callback
